binary_satisfied: A pawn walking left faces left (flipX=true), walking right faces right (flipX=false), idle holds last facing. Root transform never moved/rotated/scaled (only transform.position.x is READ for delta) so PathGrid.WorldToCell cells/reservations/eject are untouched and the pawn cannot drift off its cell. Child localPosition never written (PawnSpriteBob keeps sole ownership of child Y) - only SpriteRenderer.flipX is set on the body child.

implementation_summary.self_attach: FlickerLight.cs pattern copied: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] Bootstrap spawns hidden ~PawnFacingDriver (HideAndDontSave, DontDestroyOnLoad). Driver Time-throttled scan (1.0s) of all PawnMovement instances -> EnsureOn adds one PawnFacing per pawn root (DisallowMultipleComponent + null guard = idempotent, picks up mid-game spawns).
implementation_summary.body_renderer_location: Same wiring as PawnSpriteBob: visible body SpriteRenderer is on child named 'PawnSpriteBob' (SceneSetup.Pawn wires it as PawnSpriteBob.childRenderer). PawnFacing resolves transform.Find("PawnSpriteBob").GetComponent<SpriteRenderer>(). Fallback: first child SpriteRenderer that is NOT 'PawnShadow' and NOT the root tint-anchor renderer.
implementation_summary.facing_logic: Per-frame: dx = root.position.x - lastX. dx > epsilon -> flipX=false (right); dx < -epsilon -> flipX=true (left); |dx|<=epsilon -> hold last. moveEpsilon=0.0005 SerializeField. lastX seeded in Awake from spawn pos.
implementation_summary.null_guards: rootRenderer/bodyRenderer null-safe; Update re-resolves bodyRenderer if lost then no-ops if still null; shadow explicitly excluded; root renderer explicitly excluded.

bug_pattern_firewall.#8_justSpawned_default_true: Avoided - no spawn-grace bool defaulting true; baseline seeded in Awake (position-based), pre-spawned scene pawns get a real lastX immediately.
bug_pattern_firewall.#9_runInBackground_freeze: Avoided - driver throttles via Time.unscaledTime INSIDE Update, NOT a WaitForSeconds heartbeat coroutine. No new always-on background timer added; AutoScreenshotter retains ownership of Application.runInBackground for CLI QA. Short- and long-delay QA behave identically.
bug_pattern_firewall.#7_singleton_subscription: N/A (no Singleton.OnX subscription; driver polls via Update).
